# Lollipop Drama

> Lollipop Drama is a next-generation global content ecosystem platform offering premium short-drama consumption and creator content subscription services — everyone can create, creation can be monetized, and consumption is an incentive. Lollipop Drama is committed to becoming 'the OnlyFans of the AI era', monetizing AI premium series and AI influencers.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.lollipop.im/lollipop/): Overview of the AI short drama platform
- [AI Creator Tools](https://www.lollipop.im/lollipop/creating): text-to-video, image-to-video, face swap, style transfer
- [Download App](https://www.lollipop.im/lollipop/download): iOS & Android
- [About](https://www.lollipop.im/lollipop/about): Company background and mission

## FAQ
### What is Lollipop Drama?
A next-generation global content ecosystem platform offering premium short-drama consumption and creator content subscription services. Built on the belief that everyone can create, creation can be monetized, and consumption is an incentive, Lollipop Drama is committed to becoming 'the OnlyFans of the AI era'.

### Is Lollipop Drama free to download?
Yes. Free on App Store and Google Play; premium dramas and advanced AI features via optional in-app purchases.

### How do creators make money on Lollipop Drama?
80% revenue share (industry-highest) from ads, premium subscriptions, tips, and brand sponsorships.

### What AI tools does Lollipop Drama offer?
Four core tools via the LunoTV 1.5 toolkit: text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and image/video-to-video, supporting 4K output.

### Which devices and countries support Lollipop Drama?
iOS and Android in 100+ countries, with multilingual subtitles, 4K streaming, and offline downloads.

### Can I watch short dramas offline?
Yes. Lollipop Drama supports offline downloads on both iOS and Android for watching anywhere without an internet connection.

### How many episodes does each short drama have?
Most short dramas have 20-100 episodes, each lasting 1-3 minutes. New episodes are released daily.

### What video quality does Lollipop Drama support?
Up to 4K Ultra HD streaming with automatic quality adjustment based on network speed.

### Is my personal data safe on Lollipop Drama?
Yes. We follow strict data protection protocols in compliance with international privacy standards and never sell user data to third parties.

### Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
Yes. Subscriptions can be cancelled anytime through App Store or Google Play settings, with access continuing until the end of the billing period.

### How long does it take to create an AI short drama?
With Lollipop Drama's AI tools, you can create a complete short drama episode in under an hour, no editing experience required.

### Do I need editing experience to use AI creation tools?
No. The LunoTV 1.5 toolkit provides guided workflows for text-to-image, image-to-video, and style transfer, designed for beginners.

### What languages are supported on Lollipop Drama?
English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Portuguese, Spanish, and Arabic subtitles and app interface, with more languages being added.

### How do creators withdraw their earnings?
Multiple payment methods including bank transfer, PayPal, and regional payment platforms. The 80% revenue share covers ad revenue, subscriptions, tips, and sponsorships.

### Can I share my AI-created dramas on social media?
Yes. Creators retain full rights to their AI-generated content and can share it on social media, subject to community guidelines and copyright laws.
